messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and safely: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Inspect** | Give the guitar a gentle wipe‑down, tighten loose strings, and check for cracks, loose hardware, or other damage. | A well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing and justifies a higher asking price. | | **2. Take Quality Photos** | Use natural light, capture front, back, side, headstock, bridge, sound hole, and any flaws. | Good photos attract buyers and reduce the chance of disputes over condition. | | **3. Research Comparable Listings** | Search sites like Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local classifieds for the same brand/model/year. | Helps you set a realistic price and shows you what buyers are willing to pay. | | **4. Write a Clear Description** | Include brand, model, year, serial number, finish, any upgrades, and a brief history (e.g., “used for 2 years, never in a studio”). | Transparency builds trust and reduces back‑and‑forth questions. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Reverb** – great for musical gear, buyer protection.
• **eBay** – broad audience, auction or fixed price.
• **Craigslist / Kijiji** – local, no shipping hassles.
• **Facebook Marketplace / Groups** – free, local, easy communication.
• **Local Music Stores** – consignment or direct sale. | Pick one or two that fit your comfort level with shipping vs. local pickup. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above your target to allow room for negotiation. | Buyers often expect to haggle; starting high gives you flexibility. | | **7. Decide on Payment Method** | • **Cash** – safest for local sales.
• **PayPal / Venmo** – secure for online transactions.
• **Escrow services** (e.g., Reverb’s Escrow) – protects both parties. | Avoid checks or wire transfers unless you’re sure of the buyer. | | **8. Arrange Safe Pickup/Shipping** | • For local sales, meet in a public place (coffee shop, police station parking lot).
• For shipping, use a sturdy case, bubble wrap, and insure the package. | Protects you from fraud and ensures the guitar arrives intact. | | **9. Handle Negotiations Professionally** | Keep responses polite, stick to your minimum acceptable price, and be ready to walk away if offers fall below that threshold. | Maintains your bargaining power and keeps the process stress‑free. | | **10. Finalize the Sale** | Once payment is confirmed, hand over the instrument, provide any original paperwork (manual, warranty card), and keep a record of the transaction. | Documentation protects you in case of disputes. | ### Quick Tips & Common Pitfalls | Tip | Explanation | |-----|-------------| | **Avoid “too good to be true” offers** | If someone offers far above market value or insists on unconventional payment, it may be a scam. | | **Use a reputable shipping carrier** | UPS, FedEx, or USPS with tracking + insurance is best for valuable items. | | **Consider consignment** | If you’re uncomfortable negotiating, local music shops often offer consignment—sell through them and they handle the sale. | | **Keep receipts** | For tax purposes or future resale, having proof of purchase and condition can be handy. | | **Be honest about wear** | Over‑promising can lead to returns or bad reviews. | #### Example Listing Template ``` Title: 2008 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition Description: - Brand/Model: Yamaha FG800 - Year: 2008 - Finish: Natural - Condition: Light play marks, no cracks, all hardware functioning - Extras: Original case, extra strings, cleaning kit - History: Used for 2 years, never in a studio, stored indoors Price: $350 (Negotiable) Photos: [Attach 5–6 clear images] Contact: Email me at example@email.com or DM on Facebook. Local pickup preferred; shipping available for $30 (insured). Payment via PayPal or cash. ``` Feel free to adapt this template to your guitar’s specifics. Good luck with the sale!
